messages:
jordan-cs: Heads up — Acme PROD hit a spike of errors + weird outputs after an automatic region failover. They say embeddings suddenly dropped to 768 dims and generation responses got cut off. Ticket #4521 attached.
sam-support: Can you paste a failing request id and the customer's original model they expected?
jordan-cs: req=req_01. They were pinned to model-embed-std-v2 (1536) originally. Error started ~2024-04-17T10:12:05Z.
sam-support: Got it. Sharing route logs from the time:
```
[2024-04-17T10:12:05Z] route_decision: primary eu-west-1 unreachable, trying standby ap-southeast-1
[2024-04-17T10:12:05Z] model_selector: allow_fallbacks=true
[2024-04-17T10:12:05Z] chosen_variant: model-embed-lite-v0 (embed_dim=768)
[2024-04-17T10:12:06Z] serve_start req:req_01 variant:model-embed-lite-v0
[2024-04-17T10:12:06Z] serve_end req:req_01 status:200
```
sam-support: And the API response that hit the customer (snippet):
```
{"request_id":"req_01","model":"model-embed-lite-v0","embedding_len":768,"status":"200"}
```
alex-eng: Yikes. Looks like the routing policy allowed a capacity-friendly "lite" variant for the embedding endpoint. We should never fallback to a variant with different embedding dim for the same endpoint.
chen-ml: Also noting: lite-v0 uses a different tokenizer config and smaller vocab window — can cause truncation on long prompts and differing tokenization offsets. That explains their generation truncation complaints.
maria-oncall: Who flipped the fallback config? ops-bot, any automated change or incident around 10:12?
ops-bot: Auto-failover triggered due to node healthcheck failures in eu-west-1. Policy used: fallback_policy=best_effort (allowed lower-capability variants). See incident id inc-20240417-07.
deploy-bot: During the surge we promoted standby pool ap-southeast-1 which only hosts lite variants for cost containment.
alex-eng: Immediate mitigation: 1) pin Acme to eu-west-1 dedicated capacity (if they have it) or 2) disable cross-variant fallbacks for embedding endpoints. I'll open a rollback/patch.
chen-ml: For longer-term: add per-endpoint compatibility matrix enforced by routing (embedding_dim + tokenizer_id). If mismatch, route should either failover to identical-capacity variant or return a 503 with clear explanation.
sam-support: Will notify Acme with ask: send any sample embeddings, we want to verify their client-side handling. Also suggest they validate embed length before downstream indexing.
jordan-cs: I've told them we'll pin and follow up within 30m. They want a root cause and timeline for a fix.
maria-oncall: I'm classifying this as P2 — capability mismatch on failover. Alex, can you push the rollback toggle? If not, I'll open emergency change.
alex-eng: Pushing toggle now: `PATCH /admin/fallback-policy` -> `allow_cross_variant=false` for embedding endpoints. Rolling back promotion of lite-v0 in standby pool.
ops-bot: Change applied at 2024-04-17T10:18:23Z. Confirmation: fallback_policy updated. Standby pool de-promoted lite-v0 for embedding endpoints.
deploy-bot: Note: this will increase latency/cost for region fallback until capacity stabilizes.
chen-ml: I'll run a quick audit to find any other endpoints where tokenizer_id differs across variants.
sam-support: I'll keep the ticket updated and send a short postmortem once we have root cause and timeline.
jordan-cs: Thanks — please keep me looped. Acme is sensitive about indexing errors, so we want this closed properly. :thumbsup:
